note: Klout, social influence scores, San Francisco. IVP's page: Year Invested 2011; acquired by Lithium Technologies in 2014. Round not named in our sources.
LangChain, agent framework, San Francisco. IVP's page: Partnered 2025; IVP led the $125M Series B of October 2025 at $1.25B (TechCrunch 2025-10-21), as Benchmark, Sequoia and Lux carry the mark.
LensVector, liquid-crystal autofocus optics, Mountain View CA. On IVP's 2014 list; defunct, as Menlo carries. Entry round not on record.

Limelight Networks, content delivery, Tempe AZ. IPO 2007; merged with Edgecast in 2022 to form Edgio, which filed for Chapter 11 in 2024 and sold its assets to Akamai: insolvency followed by an asset sale, so acquired. Entry round not on record.

Liveops, on-demand contact-center agents, Scottsdale AZ (Redwood City earlier). IVP's page: Year Invested 2007. The agent-network company still operates privately (its cloud software was sold to Serenova in 2016), as Menlo carries; Benchmark reads acquired. Round not named in our sources.
LivingSocial, daily deals, Washington DC. Acquired by Groupon in 2016. IVP's round is not named in our sources.
LoopNet, commercial real-estate listings, San Francisco. IPO 2006 (LOOP); acquired by CoStar in 2012. On Redpoint's previous-by-partners list; entry round not on record.

LSI Logic, custom chips, San Jose. IVP's page: Year Invested 1980; Wikipedia: 'Initial funding of $6 million came from a consortium of venture capitalists, including Kleiner Perkins Caufield & Byers II, Institutional Venture Partners, and Technical Development Capital'. The round word is not given (the pre-2003 Series A convention is retired). Acquired by Avago in 2014.
Luminate Software, e-application management, Redwood City CA. Acquired (IVP's page names EMC; the business went to Computer Associates). Entry round not on record.
MarkMonitor, brand protection, San Francisco. IVP's page: Year Invested 2003; acquired by Thomson Reuters in 2012. Round not named in our sources.
MIPS Technologies, processor IP, Sunnyvale. IPO 1998; acquired by Imagination Technologies in 2013. Entry round not on record.
Mobile 365 (formerly InphoMatch/Mobileway), mobile messaging, Chantilly VA. IVP's page: Year Invested 2004; acquired by Sybase in 2006. Round not named in our sources.
MobileIron, mobile device management, Mountain View. IVP's page: Year Invested 2012; IPO 2014 (MOBL); acquired by Ivanti in 2020. Round not named in our sources.
MotoSport, powersports parts e-commerce, Oregon. Acquired (Liberty Interactive per IVP's page). Entry round not on record.

MySQL AB, open-source database, Uppsala (US office Cupertino). Wikipedia: 'A third round of about $18.5 million financing led by Institutional Venture Partners ... was disclosed in February 2006' (IVP's Year Invested 2005): the company's third priced round. Acquired by Sun Microsystems in 2008 for $1B.
NeoCAD, FPGA design tools, Boulder CO. Acquired by Xilinx in 1995. Entry round not on record.
NeoPhotonics, optical components, San Jose. IPO 2011 (NPTN); acquired by Lumentum in 2022. Entry round not on record.

Omniture, web analytics, Orem UT. Acquired by Adobe in 2009. IVP's page says Year Invested 2009, three years after the 2006 IPO, and no IVP fund filed on Omniture: if the position was a public purchase or sale consideration it is out (T3; the 2026-09-22 ruling). Raised for the recall pass; membership stands on the listing meanwhile.
One Kings Lane, home decor flash sales, San Francisco. IVP's page: Year Invested 2011 (Sandy Miller's deal), a round after the 2010 Series A; acquired by Bed Bath & Beyond in 2016.
Onebox.com, unified messaging, San Mateo CA. Acquired by Phone.com in 2000 (later Openwave). On Redpoint's previous-by-partners list; entry round not on record.
Platinum Software, financial software, Irvine CA; renamed Epicor Software in 1999, which Apax took private in 2011. Entry round not on record.
POPSUGAR, women's media, San Francisco. IVP's page: Year Invested 2011; acquired by Group Nine Media in 2019. Round not named in our sources.
Qadium renamed itself Expanse in 2019; the expanse row is this company (merge recorded, applies at the rebuild).
Quality Semiconductor, CMOS logic, Santa Clara CA. IPO (QUAL); acquired by IDT in 1999. Entry round not on record.
Qubole, big-data platform, Santa Clara CA (Mountain View on IVP's page). IVP's page: Year Invested 2015, announced on IVP's blog ('Qubole: Doing Big Data Right'); acquired by Idera in 2020.
Quigo Technologies, contextual advertising, New York. IVP's page: Year Invested 2006; acquired by AOL in 2007. Round not named in our sources.
Red Pepper Software, manufacturing scheduling software, San Mateo CA. Acquired by PeopleSoft in 1996. Entry round not on record.
RGB Networks, IP video delivery, Sunnyvale CA. Acquired by Imagine Communications in 2014. Entry round not on record.

Sauce Labs, cloud testing, San Francisco. IVP's archived post 'IVP Invests in Red-Hot Testing Company Sauce Labs' (2016, the firm's Year Invested): a growth round in a company on its fourth year of funding. Still private.

Seagate Technology, hard drives, Dublin (Irish-domiciled since 2010; operations in Fremont/Cupertino CA). IVP's page: Year Invested 1980, the year after founding; the round is not named. NASDAQ: STX; the web pass pins the cap.
Sequent Computer Systems, multiprocessor servers, Beaverton OR. IPO (SQNT); acquired by IBM in 1999. Entry round not on record.
Shazam, music recognition, London. IVP's page: Year Invested 2011; acquired by Apple in 2018. Round not named in our sources.
SkyStream Networks, video over IP, Sunnyvale CA. IVP's page: Year Invested 2003; acquired by Tandberg Television in 2006. Round not named in our sources.
Solace Health, patient advocacy, US. IVP leads the $130M Series C (IVP post 2026-02-10). City to be placed in the web pass.
Spiceworks, IT professional network, Austin TX. IVP's page: Year Invested 2010; acquired by Ziff Davis in 2019. Round not named in our sources.
Stratus Computer, fault-tolerant servers, Marlborough MA. IPO; acquired by Ascend Communications in 1998 (later Lucent). Entry round not on record.
SuccessFactors, talent management SaaS, South San Francisco. IPO 2007; acquired by SAP in 2012. Entry round not on record.
Suno, AI music, Cambridge MA. IVP's page: Partnered 2026 (IVP post 2026-06-03), the $400M round of June 2026 at $5.4B, as Lightspeed and USV carry; the round word to be cited in the A/B pass.
SupportSoft (renamed Support.com), support automation, Sunnyvale CA. IPO 2000; merged into Greenidge Generation in 2021. Entry round not on record.
SynOptics Communications, LAN hubs, Santa Clara CA. IPO (SNPX); merged with Wellfleet in 1994 to form Bay Networks. Entry round not on record.
Teros, application security gateways, Santa Clara CA. Acquired by Citrix in 2005. Entry round not on record.
ThreatStream renamed itself Anomali in 2016; the anomali row is this company (merge recorded, applies at the rebuild).
TransferWise renamed itself Wise in 2021; the wise row is this company (merge recorded, applies at the rebuild).
Tripwire, change auditing and security, Portland OR. IVP's page: Year Invested 2002; acquired by Thoma Bravo (2011), Belden (2015) and Fortra (2022). Round not named in our sources.
IVP's 2018-2020 pages list Whip Media under its TV Time app (same leader, address and description); the whip-media-group row is this company (merge recorded, applies at the rebuild).
